{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", duplicates)

# Check which patients are duplicated and their sample_seq
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nFirst few duplicate patient records:")
duplicate_patients.head(10)"}
